candidate.user_submission: Di pikin no dey convulse now. Dem never see convulsion for am before. Di pikin no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. No blood dey inside stool. Cholera dey for di area. For how e dey drink, e dey drink poorly. E no dey restless or irritable. When dem pinch e skin, e skin normal. E eyes dey sunken. Di diarrhoea don last 3 days. Di pikin na 24 months. E no get cough or any wahala to breathe. E dey get diarrhoea. E no get ear problem. E no get fever.
